entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:5
segments: Often and in a variety of ways the Lord shows that, while it is not his will that his ministers should be rich, or engage in worldly business for gain, it is his will that they should receive a support for themselves and their families, and devote themselves cheerfully and faithfully to their appropriate work.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:8
segments: Patrimony; other property besides what he received officially as a Levite.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:12
segments: Pretended conversation with evil spirits, and all seeking of information or any good from those who pretend to have such conversation, are an abomination in the sight of God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:13
segments: Be perfect; sincerely, heartily, and wholly devoted to God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:15
segments: A Prophet; referring to Jesus Christ.
Of thy brethren; one who shall have the same human nature with them.  Compare

. 
 
  Like unto me; standing, as Moses did, at the head of a new dispensation, and being, like him, a mediator between God and his people.  Compare

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:18
segments: Moses was in various respects an eminent type of Christ, especially in acting as mediator between God and the people, and making known to them his will.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:19
segments:
Require it of him; call him to account and punish him for his neglect. 
 
If he who rejected the testimony of Moses and despised his law died without mercy, of how much sorer punishment will he be thought worthy who rejects the testimony of Christ and despises his commands?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 18:22
segments:
Speaketh in the name of the Lord; pretends to do it, and to foretell future events. 
 
God has given to men, in the holy Scriptures, the means of judging, and by these they are bound to judge whether those who profess to speak in his name, do or do not declare his truth.
